summary: Unconditionally writes the DWORD value 0xFFFFFF (white RGB) to each of four output locations given by pointers a1, a2, a3, a4, then returns a4. A leaf utility used to initialize four UI color values in one call.

local_names.a4: fourth output pointer receiving 0xFFFFFF; also the return value

operations.description: Return the a4 pointer after writing all four colors.

unresolved: The four written pointers are only characterized as UI color outputs by the existing analysis prose; no owning class or caller is evidenced in the packet.
0xFFFFFF is interpreted as a white RGB color, but the packet provides no independent color-context evidence beyond the literal.
